data.title: STOCKS | Lululemon Slips on China Sales, Tesla Rolls Out Cybercab Service
data.description:
Lululemon shares fell after revenue in mainland China dropped 2% in the second quarter on a currency-adjusted basis, according to Bloomberg.

Tesla shares also declined after it formally launched Cybercab robotaxi service. The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened a probe into the process and technical data Tesla used to self-certify the vehicles as compliant with federal safety standards.

Robinhood fell after AMC Entertainment Chief Executive Adam Aron criticized the platform over its tokenized version of AMC shares.

data.title: STOCKS | Stablecoin Pullback Challenges Bessent's Treasury-Buyer Thesis
data.description:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said stablecoin companies could become trillion-dollar buyers of US government debt, according to Bloomberg.

The retreat in stablecoins is testing that view.

data.title: Team Falcons Odds Surge on Polymarket Ahead of BLAST Open Porto Playoff Match
data.description: Polymarket’s submarket for Map 1 winner in the Counter-Strike playoff event Team Falcons vs. G2 at BLAST Open Porto saw Team Falcons’ implied win probability jump from 51.5% one hour earlier to 92%, a 40.5 percentage point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp move may reflect the impact of breaking news related to the event.

data.title: Steakhouse Financial Begins Planned OpSec Hardening for Morpho and Box Vaults
data.description:
Steakhouse Financial said it is carrying out planned operational security hardening across all of its Morpho and Box vaults. According to Foresight News, vault operations will not be interrupted, and the vaults' risk exposure will remain unchanged.

Depositors and integrators do not need to take any action. During the process, the team will choose two of four candidate addresses to add as new Allocators for each vault, and may later remove the old Allocator addresses that have been deprecated.

Steakhouse Financial said Allocator additions and removals for its Morpho and Box vaults are not subject to a timelock.

data.title: Term Labs Hacker Deposits 400 ETH Into Tornado Cash, Total Reaches 960 ETH
data.description: The hacker behind Term Labs has deposited 400 ETH into Tornado Cash, bringing the total deposited to 960 ETH. According to Odaily, the deposits were made in ETH.

data.title: Pendle Launches on Robinhood Chain With sNET Market
data.description:
Pendle said it has launched on Robinhood Chain, adding a native fixed-income and yield-trading layer to the chain's DeFi ecosystem. According to Foresight News, the first market is sNET, which matures on September 17, 2026, and more markets will follow.

Robinhood Chain users can now use Pendle to lock in fixed income, trade leveraged exposure to token yields, or earn fees and rewards by providing liquidity. sNET is the staking receipt token for NET, which is issued by NetNet Capital.

NetNet Capital is a reserve-backed DeFi protocol on Robinhood Chain designed around the OlympusDAO v1 framework. NET is backed by USDG reserves in the treasury, and users receive sNET after staking NET. sNET is a yield-bearing token that rebases automatically every eight hours, increasing its share count.

data.title: MEME Rebounds More Than 30% as Market Cap Briefly Tops $120 Million
data.description: MEME rebounded more than 30% in a short period, and its market capitalization briefly rose above $120 million. According to Odaily, Robinhood co-founder Vlad Tenev previously posted on X that he supports stock tokens.

data.title: Hargreaves Lansdown Offers Bitcoin and Ethereum ETNs to 2 Million Clients
data.description:
Hargreaves Lansdown, the U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, said it will offer 9 Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded notes to 2 million clients, reversing its previous warning stance on crypto investing. According to ChainCatcher, the new products come from issuers including iShares, CoinShares, WisdomTree, 21Shares, Invesco, and Bitwise, with annual fees ranging from 0% to 0.35%.

New buyers must complete a suitability assessment and wait 24 hours before trading. The move follows the U.K. Financial Conduct Authority's removal of its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October last year. Hargreaves Lansdown, which manages more than $200 billion in assets, still says Bitcoin is not an asset class, but it is now offering clients Bitcoin and Ethereum exposure through its mainstream investment service rather than a crypto exchange.

data.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev Backs Stock Tokens as Legal Chief Responds to AMC CEO
data.description: Robinhood Chief Executive Officer and co-founder Vlad Tenev said on X that he fully supports stock tokens. According to Odaily, Robinhood Chief Legal Officer Dan Gallagher also responded to AMC CEO Adam Aron, saying the company knows a little about U.S. securities law and will not stop. Gallagher added that AMC can send its lawyers, and Robinhood will educate them.

data.title: Polaris Raises $1 Million in Angel Funding for On-Chain Yield Protocol
data.description:
Polaris, a permissionless on-chain yield protocol, has completed a $1 million angel funding round. According to Foresight News, the round included participation from the Ethereum Foundation, Fusion under IPOR, Altitude, Liquity, LI.FI, and more than 30 founders and contributors, including Daily Gwei founder Anthony Sassano.

Polaris centers on pETH, a yield-bearing reserve asset, and also offers USDp and GOLDp. The project aims to provide native yield for any on-chain asset.

data.title: Polaris Raises $1 Million in Angel Funding From Ethereum Foundation and Others
data.description: Polaris said it has completed a $1 million angel funding round with participation from the Ethereum Foundation, Fusion under IPOR, Altitude, Liquity, LI.FI, and more than 30 founders and contributors, including Daily Gwei founder Anthony Sassano. According to Odaily, the project is a permissionless on-chain yield protocol whose core product is the yield-bearing reserve asset pETH, alongside USDp and GOLDp, designed to provide native yield for any on-chain asset.

data.title: G2-Focused Prediction Market Position Worth $195,000 Appears Ahead of CS2 Blast Quarterfinal
data.description:
A profitable account bought $195,000 worth of G2 to beat Team Falcons in the CS2 Blast Open event, with an average entry price of 41.3 cents and 237,996 shares. According to Odaily, the address also holds $33,000 in a Map 1 G2 win position and $80,000 in G2 to win with a 1.5-map handicap.

The match between G2 and Team Falcons began at 22:00 on September 4 in a best-of-three format and is part of the Blast quarterfinals. The winner will advance to face Team Spirit in the semifinals.

data.title: Virtuoso Says Fall Luxury Travel Bookings Jump 59% as Wealthy Shift Holidays to September and October
data.description:
According to CNBC, Virtuoso said fall bookings for luxury travel and experiences are up 59% from last year, while sales rose 69%, as wealthy travelers move holidays from summer to September and October to avoid crowds. September sales are up 77%, October sales are up 54% and November sales are up 71%, and Virtuoso vice president Misty Belles said September is overtaking August as a peak month.

The global luxury travel network said Paris is the top destination for wealthy Americans this fall, followed by the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera, Tuscany and New York. London, Lake Como, Maui and Rome are also among the most popular destinations. Virtuoso said average daily hotel rates are up 131% in the Greek Isles, 78% in Puglia and 179% in the French Riviera, while bookings at hotels charging $1,500 or more per night are up 37% from last year and luxury international hotels now average $1,653 a night, up from $985 in 2019.

data.title: White House Economic Adviser Hassett Says He Did Not Advise the Fed
data.description: White House National Economic Council Director Hassett said he spoke with U.S. President Donald Trump last night and did not offer advice to the Federal Reserve. According to Odaily, Hassett said the U.S. will immediately feel the impact of future prices, respects the Fed's independence, and is doing everything possible to lower prices. He also said interest-rate hikes are considered an option on the table and that high oil prices are a short-term phenomenon.

data.title: Bank of Montreal Economist Says Canada’s Jobs Data Faces Reality Check
data.description: According to Jin10, Bank of Montreal chief economist Douglas Porter said Canada appears set for a reality check after employment data had outperformed expectations for some time. He said the August jobs report was undoubtedly weak but not especially surprising, partly reflecting a continued decline in the labor force population, and added that slower job and average wage growth would reinforce the Bank of Canada’s strategy of keeping rates unchanged and help ease overly high expectations for rate hikes. Canada’s overall employment fell by 41,700 in August, ending a run of strong job growth, while the unemployment rate held at 6.4%.

data.title: White House National Economic Council Director Hassett: Refined Fuel Prices Remain High
data.description: According to Jin10, White House National Economic Council Director Hassett said refined fuel prices remain high.

data.title: White House NEC Director Hassett: Rate Hikes Are On The Table
data.description: According to Jin10, White House National Economic Council Director Hassett said rate hikes are an option on the table.

data.title: White House NEC Director Hassett: Tracking Oil Passing Through the Strait
data.description: According to Jin10, White House National Economic Council Director Hassett said, in reference to Iran, that oil is being tracked as it passes through the strait.

data.title: Florida University Signs Multi-Year Sponsorship Deal With Ripple
data.description:
Florida University has announced a multi-year sponsorship agreement with Ripple that is expected to bring the school $5 million annually, according to people familiar with the matter cited by the Associated Press. According to Foresight News, neither side disclosed the specific financial terms.

The agreement takes effect this Saturday, when Florida University plays Florida Atlantic University. The XRP logo will appear inside Florida Field, and Ripple will provide fintech education support covering traditional finance and digital assets for Florida University student-athletes and the campus community.

data.title: U.S. and Three European Countries Seek IAEA Resolution on Iran Next Week
data.description: According to Jin10, diplomats said the United States and three European countries are seeking to pass a resolution at next week’s International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Board of Governors meeting to refer Iran’s case to the U.N. Security Council, citing Iran’s violation of its nonproliferation obligations.
